lines.en: - Hey. - Hey, so what do you think?
Now, they're a little more than I usually spend on boots.
I'm gonna miss being able to afford food.
I'm sorry, they just-- they just look so good.
And the saleswoman was looking at me like, "Ugh, these are way too extensive for you."
Yeah, well, too bad we're gonna have to return them.
Honey, I'm not returning them, okay?
I mean, I know they cost a lot, but I'm gonna wear them all the time.
I mean, have you ever had something that was so beautiful that everyone wants it?
Nice try. I'm keeping the boots.
